title: Manager, Delivery Solutions Architects
description: FEQ427R546 You will build and lead a team of Delivery Solution Architects (DSAs) responsible for the post-sales success of Databricks' customers. This is one of the most consequential delivery leadership roles in the company. The customers in your portfolio and your team's work directly determine how quickly Data and AI transform how they do business. As a DSA Manager, you set the technical strategy across your portfolio, decide where to invest your team's capacity, and partner with Sales, Pre-Sales, Professional Services, and our Systems Integrator ecosystem to move use cases from kickoff to production.
